Diffusion

Jun 2026

Image generation and editing

I built a Streamlit application around Stable Diffusion 1.5 for image generation, masked editing, and outpainting. I completed this Dicoding course project independently.

Generative AI
Certificates

Problem

Give users control over both image generation and targeted edits in a single interface.

My role

Implemented the diffusion pipeline, editing workflows, and Streamlit application.

Approach

Exposed seeds, negative prompts, and sampling settings, with canvas masks for inpainting and image expansion.

Key decision

Used deterministic seeds for repeatable generation and blended mask boundaries to connect edited regions.

Result

Delivered an interactive application for generation, inpainting, and outpainting.

Tools and methods

  • Stable Diffusion 1.5
  • Streamlit
  • Inpainting
  • Outpainting
